origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: D lmelk n lqaεa yeṭṭfen taɛrabt, yeṭṭfen deg waman, yezmer ad d-yessiwel d imdukal-is, yeṭṭef cwiṭ, yeffus ɣef lqaεa.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Yeffu aman akken d lehwa yerna yettwali s tidett deg-s ur d-yeffiɣ ara.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Timineḍ s tɣawla d tameqqrant, mi ara d-ternuḍ.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: Yettḥewwiṣ cwiṭ s tɣawla deg waman.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Aman yeffren
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: Yettεumm akken iwata ɣef lqaεa n lebḥeṛ, mačči kan deg-s.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Taɣawsiwt taɣawsiwt
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Yeṭṭef lqaεa mi ara d-yeɣli deg lqaεa am wakken ad d-yeɣli.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Iɣil n yiɣil
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Yezmer kan ad yečče iselman. Imḍebbren n uselkimen zemren ad tt-id-ssekren deg uselkim (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Tameẓla n uḍan d usemmiḍ d ayen i d-yettunefken am tin i d-yettunefken.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Yettḥewwiṣen deg waman s yiɣallen iǧehden, iqeddcen  ugar n yimdanen n lqaεa.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Tiɣriwin i d-yettunefk i ṭṭlam n lekmal.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Yessuɣal 30% n lbaṭel i d-yettunefkan i wid i d-yessekren.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 wulawen (+4 max HP). Tiɣriwin n lebḥeṛ n lqaεa ttbeddun yiwen n useqqamu ugar.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Timinen s tɣawla d tameqqrant ula mi d-teqqen.
Yeḥla s ttawil mi yella deg waman  azal n 1 HP yal 3 isseknen.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: Yeṭṭef 1.5 n lbaṭel deg tis snat mi ara d-yefk tafat n yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Yeɣli-d
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Aḍu yeɣli-d ma ulac aman: lqaεa yeṭṭef aṭas, ad t-tessukkes. Tameɣli, amḍan n waman, aεemmi n waman neɣ yiwen n uḥric n waman i d-yeffɣen ɣer tama-s, akk-n tt-id-yeṭṭfen.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Voidwalker
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: Aḥric i d-yettwaṭṭef s taggara  yeṭṭef-itt deg yixef, yeṭṭef-itt ɣef yixef meqqren, yettɛedday ur t-id-ttwalin ara ugar n tɣawsiwin.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Isebtaren i sɛan azday ɣer wemkan i d-tettwaliḍ ( armi d 24 n tneggayin).
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Tzemreḍ ad twaliḍ deg ṭṭlam amḍiq.
Imezdaɣ ur ttwalin ara iman-ik ma ur ten-teḍriḍ ara.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Yeṭṭef 1 n lbaṭel ɣef ddqiqa mi yella deg waman neɣ deg ugeffur  lbaṭel yugad aman.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: Ur d-yefki ara lxuf deg uḍar.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Stoneguard
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: Ilul-d seg uẓru yeddren  d aɛessas ur neǧǧi ara ad yeɣli ɣef wid i t-yettwaṭṭfen, yeṭṭef iẓuran s ifassen-is, yeǧǧi-d iẓuran n tẓegwa ɣer ṭṭlam.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 wulawen (+6 HP max). Amḍan n wedrar yesɛan ugar n tfekka.
Yettunefk 20% n wayen i d-yettunefken i wid i d-yeṭṭfen.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: Yettḥewweṣ 10% s tɣawla ugar n wemdan amaynut.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Yeɣli-d tiɣriwin snat n tikwal s tɣawla.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Imuḍan ur d-yeffɣen ara deg 48 n tɣiwanin.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Verdant
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: D amedya yeddren n umaḍal azegzaw  ur neεyi ara, deg talwit akked tmedyazt, maca yettwaḥesben s lekmal n Nether.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Imezdaɣ akk  gar-asen wid i d iɛdawen  ttḥeqren fell-am ma ur k-d-yeqbel ara.
Iẓuran ttḥewwin yal tafat, ur d-teṭṭef ara lbaṭel.
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: Ur d-yefki ara lxuf deg uḍar.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: S ttawilat i d-yettunefki tazmert-is mi yella deg yiɣersiwen n teẓgi.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: Yeṭṭef 2 n tɣawsiwin deg tis snat mi yella deg Nether. Isebtaren n Frost Walker ḥebsen akk tiɣawsiwin-nni.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Aqcic n ṭṭlam  yeǧǧa-d lbaṭel n tesraft tazeggazt, yeǧǧa-d lbaṭel gar-asen, yeǧǧa-d iseflawen.
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Shadow Dash
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Yeffɣen ɣer zdat s tɣawla tameqqrant deg ubrid i d-teddun, yesεa 2 n tezmert.
Yeṭṭef 1 n tɣawsiwin deg tis snat mi ara d-yeffɣen i tafat n yiṭij.

power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: Ur d-yefki ara lxuf deg uḍar.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Orb n tnegga
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Ssiweḍ-ed armi d 4 n tmeskin i d-yedduklen deg yiwet n tikelt; ssebba i d-yedduklen, tessufeɣ-d tameqqrant.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Yettwaṭṭef-ik s tezmert deg tama i d-tettmuqul, yesεa 2 n tezmert, yesεa 4 n tayezzant.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Iferḍan n udrar
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Yettazzal s tilelli deg lehwa s yiɣilen iǧehden.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Yeffu-d 4 n yiɣallen n tmes i d-yettmuqulen ɣer tama i d-tettmuqulen.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: D tidett i d-yefkan
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Imɣan i d-iteddun deg udem-im, ttɣil s tɣawla, amzun d lbaṛakat n wakal.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Yettwaṭṭef
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Yettwaṭṭef akk iɣersiwen i d-yezgan deg umkan-is s Slowness VI i d-yeffɣen 4 n yissekunden.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Isebtaren i sɛan azday deg umkan anda tettmuqul.

origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Inchling

origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Tameẓla
